name: az-investigator
description: Install Azure CLI + Azure MCP into an ephemeral ai-sandbox container in a way that survives rebuilds, then run KQL investigations against your Azure Log Analytics workspaces (stg/qa/trunk/prod). Includes a workspace-vs-component RBAC fallback wrapper, per-env resource discovery, battle-tested KQL templates for backend traces / BI events / 401 spikes / game-vendor plays / user timelines, and proof-discipline guardrails that distinguish confirmed findings from hypotheses.
compatibility: OpenCode running in a Docker ai-sandbox (Debian) on macOS host, with /home/<user> bind-mounted from host, npm + python3 + curl available, and an Azure AD account that has previously logged in via az login (MSAL cache at ~/.azure persists across sandbox rebuilds).
